title: Common Values Nyhamnen
intro: Explores how culture and existing buildings can become active resources in urban development. Using Nyhamnen in Malmö as a testing ground, the project combines spatial mapping with economic, legal and organisational analysis and real-scale pilots in existing buildings. The work develops and tests a planning and business model for how cultural activities can be established early, how shared values can be identified and managed, and how existing places can remain in use throughout long urban development processes.
